name: Reducto
description: Agentic document platform — parse, extract, split, classify, and edit documents (PDFs, images, spreadsheets, and 30+ file types) with citations. Primary agent interface today is MCP + REST API.

bearerAuth.description: Use a Reducto API key from https://studio.reducto.ai.

skills.name: Parse
skills.description: Convert documents into structured text, tables, and figures with citation-ready output.

skills.name: Extract
skills.description: Extract typed JSON fields with citations on every value.

skills.name: Split
skills.description: Split documents into named sections and page ranges.

skills.name: Classify
skills.description: Classify documents against a plain-language taxonomy.

skills.name: Edit
skills.description: Edit PDFs and DOCX files with natural-language instructions.
